record.name: Marshal
record.description: Marshals are law enforcement officers and peacekeepers, using their authority and tactical skills to maintain order and protect communities.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: A stalwart guardian of peace and justice

progression_tree.description: You gain proficiency in one type of artistic tool, one language, and one type of musical instrument. You can also choose to gain proficiency in a combat sport or a musical instrument as a bonus feat.

effects.notes: With careful training, the Marshal develops a keen awareness of their surroundings, granting proficiency in one tool or skill of their choice: Artistic Tool, Language, Musical Instrument, Combat Sport, or Performance. This focus on discipline and self-control also lends itself to expertise in Intimidation checks.

progression_tree.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks. You can also use your reaction to ask the DM for information about a creature within 30 feet of you, and the DM must provide truthful information.

effects.notes: The Marshal's eyes blaze with an inner light, granting them keen insight. Whenever they land a hit against a foe, the Justice's Eye effect activates, imbuing their Wisdom Perception with a surge of clarity and focus.

progression_tree.description: You gain a +2 bonus to Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Perception) checks. You can also use your action to analyze a scene or piece of evidence, and you gain advantage on one Investigation check of your choice within the next hour.

effects.notes: As I focus my mind, I gain a surge of tactical awareness. My Intelligence Investigation and Wisdom Perception abilities are heightened for this moment, allowing me to rapidly analyze the situation at hand.

progression_tree.description: You gain a +3 bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) and Strength checks. You can also use your action to disarm a creature or disable a trap, and you gain advantage on one Acrobatics check of your choice within the next hour.

effects.notes: With a swift and precise motion, you disarm or disable your opponent's attack, leaving them momentarily off balance.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Standing with feet shoulder-width apart, blaster at the ready, with a determined look on their face.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A soft blue glow emanating from their lightsaber hilt, pulsing in sync with their breathing.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A lone marshal stands guard on a desert planet, surrounded by endless dunes, with a worn blaster slung over their shoulder and a look of quiet resolve on their face.
